q: The taller I am, the shorter I become as I stay lit, and I'm afraid of even the smallest gust of wind. What am I?
I can't be held or seen, but I never stop moving, and no one can ever get me back once I've passed. What am I?
I follow you everywhere on a sunny day, but I disappear completely the moment the light goes out. What am I?
I have no sound of my own, but you only truly hear me when everyone stops talking. What am I?
I visit you while you sleep, and I vanish the moment you open your eyes. What am I?
I let you visit yesterday anytime you like, even though you can never really travel back in time. What am I?
I'm something only a few people know, and once I'm told to everyone, I disappear forever. What am I?
I'm a few simple words, but breaking me can hurt more than breaking a bone. What am I?
The more I'm repeated, the harder I become to break, even when you want to stop. What am I?
I'm a feeling that keeps you looking forward to tomorrow, even on your hardest day. What am I?
I'm made of sounds and symbols, and every country seems to speak a different version of me. What am I?
I'm a number, but I mean there's nothing there at all. What am I?
I always end with a curl like a fishhook, and I'm asking to be answered. What am I?
I match the last sounds of two words, like 'cat' and 'hat.' What am I?
I'm what you make silently before blowing out birthday candles. What am I?
I'm always the same no matter who tells me, while my opposite can change with every storyteller. What am I?
I'm a story that isn't true, and the more I'm told, the harder I am to keep straight. What am I?
Nobody plans to make me, but everybody does now and then, and I'm often how people learn best. What am I?
I decide who wins a coin flip, and nobody can ever be completely sure what I'll bring. What am I?
I'm the only thing in life that never stops happening, no matter how much you resist. What am I?
I grow bigger the farther apart two places are, but I shrink to nothing when you arrive. What am I?
I'm the story of everything that has already happened, and I can never be rewritten, only retold. What am I?
Nobody has ever seen me, yet everybody is walking toward me every single second. What am I?
I'm shorter than a minute, yet a photograph can freeze me forever. What am I?
I copy everything you do, but only when you stand in front of glass or still water. What am I?
I'm speech so quiet that only someone very close can hear me. What am I?
I sneak up on you when you're tired, and I'm strangely catching if you see someone else do me. What am I?
I use far fewer muscles than a frown, yet I can make a stranger feel like a friend. What am I?
I'm given to you before you can even talk, and people use me to call you across a room. What am I?
I grow by exactly one every single year, whether you want me to or not. What am I?
I can count how many, but I have no color, shape, or smell of my own. What am I?
I can be true or made up, but either way I need a beginning, a middle, and an end. What am I?
I make your heart race and your hands feel cold, even when nothing is really chasing you. What am I?
I spread from person to person faster than a yawn, especially when someone tells a good joke. What am I?
I can travel anywhere in the universe in an instant, without ever leaving your head. What am I?
I stand at every fork in the road of your day, waiting for you to pick a path. What am I?
I can be north, south, east, or west, but I have no shape you could ever hold. What am I?
I'm every single yesterday that has ever happened, and I only grow bigger with each new day. What am I?
I change four times a year, bringing snow, blossoms, sunshine, or falling leaves. What am I?
I show exactly where you've been, but the very next wave or gust of wind can erase me completely. What am I?
I start as a whisper between two people, but by the time I've traveled far enough, I barely resemble the truth. What am I?
I can appear in your head in a single flash, yet I might change the whole world once you share me. What am I?
I'm what every question is searching for, though sometimes I take a while to be found. What am I?
I burst out of you suddenly and loudly, usually right after your nose starts to tickle. What am I?
I'm a few kind words given for free, but I can make someone's whole day brighter. What am I?
I cost nothing to give away, yet I'm one of the most valuable things you can share with a stranger. What am I?
I fill your head with endless 'why' and 'how' questions about the world around you. What am I?
I'm the quiet ability to wait calmly, even when every part of you wants to rush. What am I?
I let you build entire castles and dragons using nothing but the inside of your own mind. What am I?
I ask a tricky question in a clever disguise, and you're solving one of me right now. What am I?
